label: Portal Nacional de Contratações Públicas
terms_note: Brazilian open data (Lei 14.133); anonymous; no rate limit in the spec read.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (public consulta API — search + details). Lane `assist` → **api for search**. Confidence high.

endpoints.purpose: search — contratações with open proposal period
endpoints.notes: objetoCompra, valorTotalEstimado, dataAberturaProposta, dataEncerramentoProposta, orgaoEntidade, unidadeOrgao, linkSistemaOrigem

reference.limits: - Open data; proposals in the origin system (linkSistemaOrigem).

adapter.rate_note: The consultation API is keyless and publishes no rate limit in its OpenAPI (https://pncp.gov.br/api/consulta/v3/api-docs). Two requests per second.
adapter.terms: Brazilian public open data (Lei 14.133/2021 PNCP). Proposals are submitted on the buyer's electronic procurement system (linkSistemaOrigem, e.g. Compras.gov.br), not through PNCP.

search_postings.note: GET /v1/contratacoes/proposta ('Consultar Contratações com Recebimento de Propostas Aberto'): procurements whose proposal period is open now. dataFinal (required, AAAAMMDD) is fixed to 20991231 so every open procurement is included; pagina = page, tamanhoPagina = limit and must be 10–50 (a smaller limit is refused with 400 'must be greater than or equal to 10'). The API has no keyword filter, so `query` and min_budget are not sent; `category` is the numeric codigoModalidadeContratacao (e.g. 6 = Pregão Eletrônico, 8 = Dispensa). budget_max = valorTotalEstimado (BRL), url = linkSistemaOrigem (the buyer's system where proposals are submitted), deadline = dataEncerramentoProposta; uf/município are in raw.unidadeOrgao. A page past the end answers 204 (empty list).

not_offered.me: Keyless consultation API; no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The per-procurement call is GET /v1/orgaos/{cnpj}/compras/{ano}/{sequencial}, which needs the three parts of numeroControlePNCP separately; the vocabulary's single id cannot be split, so re-read the record from the search hit.
not_offered.submit_bid: PNCP only publishes procurements; proposals are submitted in the buyer's own system (linkSistemaOrigem).
not_offered.bid_status: No proposal API; results appear later as atas/contratos in the consultation API.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API in the consultation API.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API in the consultation API.
